scope: Protocol selection, live input/context/prompt contracts, provider transport, user-visible discussion replay and cross-domain synthesis

findings.title: Preflight accepts selected evidence that cannot fit any proposal request
findings.trigger: A selected UTF-8 attachment has 40,000 CJK characters (120,000 bytes), fits the upload limit and 20 evidence passages, with the ordinary sample brief.
findings.impact: The real preflight input check returns no error. Intake succeeds; all three proposals fail context_limit before authorization, and the run fails without a recommendation. Character/passage limits do not imply the 128,000-byte complete JSON packet fits.
findings.recommendation: Build and size the exact canonical initial packet during preflight, including UTF-8 encoding and all overhead. Reserve a bounded peer/claim context envelope for mandatory downstream stages, with explicit coverage when selecting context. Reject or ask for narrower excerpts before starting.
findings.acceptance_check: Boundary/property cases across ASCII, multi-byte UTF-8, quotes/escapes, maximum selected passages and peer/claim growth must either fit the declared envelopes or produce a preflight blocker.

findings.title: The discussion activity view silently stops at the first 100 events
findings.trigger: A run accumulates more than 100 committed events, such as through retries, research or reconciliation.
findings.impact: Snapshot intentionally returns the first 100 events plus next_event_cursor, but the frontend never consumes the cursor or events endpoint. A 134-event reproduction shows only sequences 1-100 and omits the late concern. Polling repeats the same prefix and stops on terminal status; raw server history remains available.
findings.proof: root/probe-results.json:event_snapshot_pagination; API reproduction plus static client call-path inspection
findings.recommendation: Fetch bounded event pages through the snapshot cutoff and merge by (run_id, sequence); expose loading/remaining history and retain generation fences when changing runs.
findings.acceptance_check: A component/API test with 250 events, late critical concerns, duplicate pages, reconnection and a run switch must show the complete correctly ordered history exactly once.

findings.title: Intake cannot inspect newly selected attachment content or propose a normalized brief
findings.trigger: Selected attachment text contains details relevant to resolving intake questions.
findings.impact: The first intake packet contains attachment IDs but no selected attachment passages; evidence is prepared only for proposals. ProviderOutput has no normalized-brief proposal field and proposed_brief is copied unchanged from the input. Intake is a bounded question generator, not full document-aware normalization.
findings.recommendation: Expose a validated read-only intake evidence view and a typed proposed change set with provenance. Require explicit user confirmation for changed assumptions, options or requirements before freezing the proposal brief.
findings.caveat: The blueprint orders intake before evidence preparation. This is a capability gap, not evidence that proposal agents lose the attachment; the proposal packet includes it. No live intake quality was measured.

findings.title: Schema repair retries receive no actionable validation feedback
findings.trigger: A provider returns an invalid reference or malformed/schema-invalid output and has one retry remaining.
findings.impact: The second packet differs only by repair=true. The rejected reference, failed JSON path and validation reason are absent, and the common prompt does not define repair. This implements bounded regeneration, with no demonstrated targeted correction capability.
findings.recommendation: Include sanitized bounded diagnostics with offending field paths and permitted identities, optionally the bounded rejected structured output as untrusted data; distinguish execution retry from output repair and substantive correction.
findings.caveat: A fresh generation can succeed. The reproduction proves missing feedback, not that every retry fails or that real-provider quality decreases by a measured amount.

inventory.algorithm: Protocol selection and typed stage surface
inventory.main_invariant: Only independent_review_provisional is accepted in the application; critique/revision/evidence_review exist in experimental paths, not the live state graph.

inventory.algorithm: Frozen input manifest, canonical bytes and preflight context admission
inventory.main_invariant: The selected inputs must match ownership/hash/recipient scope and be representable by admitted packets.

inventory.algorithm: Intake questions, normalized-brief handoff and confirmation
inventory.main_invariant: At most three questions; confirmed options/horizon and original authorized scope precede proposals.

inventory.algorithm: Peer packet selection and proposal independence
inventory.main_invariant: Initial proposals receive no peer outputs or current-run peer claims; synthesis sees proposals; correction sees prior synthesis/audit; audit sees latest synthesis.

inventory.algorithm: Common role prompt and structured output semantics
inventory.main_invariant: No tool authority from supplied text, preserve uncertainty/dissent, scoped references, JSON contract. Distinct provider names are the proposal roles; there is no explicit role-specialization or argument-adjudication schema.

inventory.algorithm: Provider wire schema transformation and local schema/reference validation
inventory.main_invariant: Local validation retains constraints omitted by provider wire dialects; references/options/requirements are scoped; empty audit verdicts and duplicate assessments fail.

inventory.algorithm: Schema repair classification and feedback packet
inventory.main_invariant: A second generation remains within the two-call logical-role ceiling; actual targeted repair needs explicit diagnostics.

inventory.algorithm: Provider envelope decoding, refusal and usage certainty
inventory.main_invariant: Explicit refusal is not retried to evade refusal; valid content may retain unknown usage; malformed accounting does not imply zero exposure.

inventory.algorithm: Conservative request cost and context bound
inventory.main_invariant: Bound encoded bytes plus protocol overhead and explicit billable output ceiling before send; money and context fit configured limits.

inventory.algorithm: Absolute provider transport deadline through DNS, socket and TLS
inventory.main_invariant: Every operation uses the remaining absolute deadline; DNS threads have bounded outstanding capacity; no hidden transport retry.

inventory.algorithm: Frozen provider configuration and request contract hash
inventory.main_invariant: Funding, expiry, deployment epoch and current declared prompt/schema contract must match the accepted run before a paid authorization.
Choose lowest complete known feasible cost only as a labeled simulation; never represent simulated agreement as measured factual accuracy.

inventory.algorithm: Ordered event replay, snapshot cutoff and browser history consumption
inventory.main_invariant: Committed events have unique per-run sequence; readers stay within a cutoff and consume every page without stale-run mixing.

inventory.algorithm: Browser mutation receipt, uncertain-command reconciliation and owner fence
inventory.main_invariant: An uncertain command retains its UUID/body hash and is reconciled before replay; polling does not authorize new model work; late reads are fenced.

limitations: No real-provider or paid evaluation; no fresh actual PostgreSQL/Redis/native-browser service checks; 43 backend service/profile-dependent tests skipped.
No Git metadata exists at this workspace root, so source hashes record the observed audit snapshot rather than a commit identity.
This audits discussion algorithms and their relevant correctness boundaries, not every unrelated UI layout, export renderer, hosting or backup-security property.
